Description: Hikyo host infrastructure only: Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 EC2, encrypted retained data volume, and Session Manager. Does not install Hikyo or expose inbound ports. Requires outbound access to AWS Systems Manager over HTTPS through a public subnet, NAT, or VPC endpoints.

VpcId.Description: Existing VPC with DNS support enabled. Select a subnet in this VPC.

SubnetId.Description: Existing subnet in the selected VPC. Public IP requires an internet gateway route; private subnets require NAT or Systems Manager VPC endpoints.

AssociatePublicIp.Description: Allocate a chargeable public IPv4 address. Set false for private subnets with NAT or Systems Manager VPC endpoints. This does not open inbound ports.

InstanceType.Description: x86_64 instance type; availability depends on region and subnet Availability Zone. Size for your workload.

UbuntuAmi.Description: Canonical public SSM parameter for Ubuntu Server 24.04 amd64. Resolving a newer image during stack update can replace the host; plan data migration before updating.

DataVolumeSize.Description: Data volume size in GiB. Retained and billed after stack deletion or volume replacement. Never shrink an existing volume.

Properties.GroupDescription: Hikyo host: no inbound access until operator configures TLS

SecurityGroupEgress.Description: Outbound access for Systems Manager, updates, and operator installation

InstanceId.Description: Ubuntu host; wait for Systems Manager registration before connecting

SessionManagerUrl.Description: Open an authenticated AWS console session; caller needs Session Manager permissions

DataVolumeId.Description: Retained encrypted data volume. Identify by EBS volume ID before formatting or mounting

DataVolumeAvailabilityZone.Description: The volume can attach only to an instance in this Availability Zone

DataDeviceRequested.Description: Requested device; Nitro presents it as an NVMe device with a different name

SecurityGroupId.Description: No inbound rules. Configure HTTPS only after installing and securing Hikyo
